CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.points_appointment_paid_v1(p_id_cita uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.citas c WHERE c.id_cita = p_id_cita
      AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.estado_cita_codigo = 'confirmada'
      AND NOT (COALESCE(c.es_canje_recompensa, false) AND COALESCE(c.orden_integrante, 1) <= 1)
      AND (
        (c.total_pagar_hnl > 0 AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM public.payment_intents pi JOIN public.payments p ON p.id_intent = pi.id_intent
          WHERE pi.origen_pago_codigo = 'cita' AND app_private.points_payment_valid_v1(p.id_payment)
            AND pi.moneda_codigo = c.moneda_codigo
            AND (
              (c.id_grupo_cita IS NULL AND pi.id_grupo_cita IS NULL AND pi.id_cita = c.id_cita
                AND pi.monto_hnl = c.total_pagar_hnl)
              OR (c.id_grupo_cita IS NOT NULL
                AND ((pi.id_grupo_cita = c.id_grupo_cita AND (pi.id_cita IS NULL OR EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1 FROM public.citas anchor WHERE anchor.id_cita = pi.id_cita
                    AND anchor.id_grupo_cita = c.id_grupo_cita AND anchor.deleted_at IS NULL)))
                  OR (pi.id_grupo_cita IS NULL AND EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1 FROM public.citas anchor WHERE anchor.id_cita = pi.id_cita
                    AND anchor.id_grupo_cita = c.id_grupo_cita AND anchor.deleted_at IS NULL)))
                AND pi.monto_hnl = (SELECT sum(g.total_pagar_hnl) FROM public.citas g
                  WHERE g.id_grupo_cita = c.id_grupo_cita AND g.deleted_at IS NULL))
            )
        ))
        OR EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM public.subscription_consumptions sc
          JOIN public.subscriptions s ON s.id_suscripcion = sc.id_suscripcion AND s.id_cliente = sc.id_cliente
          JOIN public.subscription_payments sp ON sp.id_suscripcion = s.id_suscripcion
          JOIN public.payments p ON p.id_payment = sp.id_payment
          JOIN public.payment_intents pi ON pi.id_intent = p.id_intent AND pi.origen_pago_codigo = 'membership'
          JOIN public.membership_purchase_orders mpo ON mpo.id_order = pi.id_membership_order
            AND mpo.id_suscripcion = s.id_suscripcion AND mpo.id_cliente = s.id_cliente
          WHERE sc.id_cita = c.id_cita AND sc.id_cliente = c.id_cliente
            AND sc.coverage_status = 'cubierto_plan' AND sc.invalidado IS FALSE
            AND sc.item_tipo = 'servicio' AND sc.id_servicio IS NOT NULL
            AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.citas_detalles cd
              WHERE cd.id_cita = c.id_cita AND cd.id_servicio = sc.id_servicio)
            AND (s.estado_suscripcion_codigo = 'activa'
              OR (s.estado_suscripcion_codigo = 'vencida' AND s.motivo_fin_codigo = 'agotamiento'))
            AND s.id_sucursal_contratada = c.id_sucursal
            AND s.inicio_at <= sc.created_at AND s.fin_at > sc.created_at
            AND sp.estado = 'pagado' AND sp.paid_at IS NOT NULL AND sp.paid_at <= clock_timestamp()
            AND sp.monto_hnl = p.monto_hnl AND sp.moneda_codigo = p.moneda_codigo
            AND mpo.estado_orden_codigo = 'pagada' AND mpo.paid_at IS NOT NULL
            AND mpo.total_hnl = p.monto_hnl AND mpo.moneda_codigo = p.moneda_codigo
            AND app_private.points_payment_valid_v1(p.id_payment)
        )
      )
  )
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.points_payment_valid_v1(p_id_payment uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.payments p
    JOIN public.payment_intents pi ON pi.id_intent = p.id_intent
    JOIN public.payment_providers pp ON pp.id_provider = pi.id_provider
    WHERE p.id_payment = p_id_payment
      AND p.estado_pago_codigo IN ('capturado', 'conciliado', 'manual_pagado')
      AND p.pago_tardio IS FALSE AND pi.estado_intent_codigo = 'confirmado'
      AND p.paid_at IS NOT NULL AND p.paid_at <= clock_timestamp()
      AND p.monto_hnl > 0 AND p.monto_hnl = pi.monto_hnl
      AND p.moneda_codigo = pi.moneda_codigo
      AND NULLIF(btrim(p.provider_tx_id), '') IS NOT NULL
      AND pp.codigo IN ('pixelpay', 'todopago')
      AND p.provider_tx_id NOT LIKE 'tx_mock_%' AND p.provider_tx_id NOT LIKE 'todopago_sim_%'
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.payment_events pe WHERE pe.id_intent = pi.id_intent
        AND (pe.evento_tipo IN ('payment.simulated.result', 'membership.simulated.result')
          OR pe.payload_esencial->>'mode' = 'preprod_simulated'))
  )
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_points_estado_final_cita()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_estado text;
BEGIN
  SELECT ec.estado_cita_codigo
  INTO v_estado
  FROM public.estados_cita ec
  WHERE lower(trim(ec.estado_cita_codigo)) IN ('completada','atendida','finalizada')
  ORDER BY
    CASE lower(trim(ec.estado_cita_codigo))
      WHEN 'completada' THEN 1
      WHEN 'atendida' THEN 2
      WHEN 'finalizada' THEN 3
      ELSE 99
    END
  LIMIT 1;

  IF v_estado IS NULL THEN
    v_estado := 'completada';
  END IF;

  RETURN v_estado;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_points_get_effective_rule(p_id_sucursal uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(id_rule uuid, id_sucursal uuid, umbral_monto_hnl numeric, puntos_por_cita integer, puntos_para_premio integer, expiracion_meses integer, activo boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT
    pr.id_rule,
    pr.id_sucursal,
    pr.umbral_monto_hnl,
    pr.puntos_por_cita,
    pr.puntos_para_premio,
    pr.expiracion_meses,
    pr.activo
  FROM public.points_rules pr
  WHERE pr.activo IS TRUE
    AND (pr.id_sucursal = p_id_sucursal OR pr.id_sucursal IS NULL)
  ORDER BY
    CASE WHEN pr.id_sucursal = p_id_sucursal THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
    pr.updated_at DESC,
    pr.created_at DESC,
    pr.id_rule DESC
  LIMIT 1
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_points_materialize_expired_cycles(p_id_cliente uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_cycle record;
  v_balance integer;
  v_total integer := 0;
BEGIN
  FOR v_cycle IN
    SELECT
      pc.id_cycle,
      pc.id_cliente,
      pc.vence_at
    FROM public.points_cycles pc
    WHERE pc.estado_ciclo_codigo = 'activo'
      AND pc.vence_at <= now()
      AND (p_id_cliente IS NULL OR pc.id_cliente = p_id_cliente)
    ORDER BY pc.id_cycle
    FOR UPDATE OF pc
  LOOP
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pt.puntos), 0)::integer
      INTO v_balance
    FROM public.points_transactions pt
    WHERE pt.id_cycle = v_cycle.id_cycle;

    IF v_balance > 0 THEN
      INSERT INTO public.points_transactions (
        id_cliente,
        id_cycle,
        tipo_puntos_codigo,
        puntos,
        vence_at,
        motivo,
        created_at,
        updated_at
      )
      VALUES (
        v_cycle.id_cliente,
        v_cycle.id_cycle,
        'vencimiento',
        v_balance,
        v_cycle.vence_at,
        'Vencimiento automatico del ciclo',
        now(),
        now()
      )
      ON CONFLICT (id_cycle, tipo_puntos_codigo)
        WHERE id_cycle IS NOT NULL
          AND tipo_puntos_codigo = 'vencimiento'
      DO NOTHING;
    END IF;

    UPDATE public.points_cycles
    SET estado_ciclo_codigo = 'expirado',
        updated_at = now()
    WHERE id_cycle = v_cycle.id_cycle
      AND estado_ciclo_codigo = 'activo';

    IF FOUND THEN
      v_total := v_total + 1;
    END IF;
  END LOOP;

  RETURN v_total;
END;
$function$

views.name: vw_points_balance
views.definition:
WITH ledger_balance AS (
         SELECT pt.id_cliente,
            COALESCE(sum(pt.puntos), 0::bigint) AS ledger_points
           FROM points_transactions pt
          GROUP BY pt.id_cliente
        ), pending_expired_cycles AS (
         SELECT pc.id_cliente,
            pc.id_cycle,
            COALESCE(sum(pt.puntos), 0::bigint) AS remaining_points
           FROM points_cycles pc
             JOIN points_transactions pt ON pt.id_cycle = pc.id_cycle
          WHERE pc.estado_ciclo_codigo = 'activo'::text AND pc.vence_at IS NOT NULL AND pc.vence_at <= now()
          GROUP BY pc.id_cliente, pc.id_cycle
        ), pending_expiration_by_client AS (
         SELECT pec.id_cliente,
            COALESCE(sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN pec.remaining_points > 0 THEN pec.remaining_points
                    ELSE 0::bigint
                END), 0::bigint::numeric) AS pending_expired_points
           FROM pending_expired_cycles pec
          GROUP BY pec.id_cliente
        )
 SELECT lb.id_cliente,
    (lb.ledger_points::numeric - COALESCE(pe.pending_expired_points, 0::bigint::numeric))::integer AS balance_puntos
   FROM ledger_balance lb
     LEFT JOIN pending_expiration_by_client pe ON pe.id_cliente = lb.id_cliente;

views.name: vw_points_redemption_services
views.definition:
SELECT prs.id_rule_service,
    pr.id_rule,
    pr.id_sucursal,
    prs.cliente_condicion_codigo,
    prs.id_servicio,
    s.nombre_servicio,
    s.descripcion AS descripcion_servicio,
    s.grupo_catalogo,
    COALESCE(prs.puntos_canje, pr.puntos_para_premio) AS puntos_requeridos,
    prs.puntos_canje AS puntos_canje_override,
    pr.puntos_para_premio AS puntos_para_premio_regla,
    prs.habilitado AS regla_servicio_activa,
    prs.visible_cliente,
    prs.orden_visual,
    pr.activo AS regla_puntos_activa,
    s.activo AS servicio_activo,
    s.visible_publico AS servicio_visible_publico,
    s.agendable AS servicio_agendable,
    prs.created_at,
    prs.updated_at
   FROM points_rule_services prs
     JOIN points_rules pr ON pr.id_rule = prs.id_rule
     JOIN servicios s ON s.id_servicio = prs.id_servicio
  WHERE s.deleted_at IS NULL;
